text:
The plate looks like a side plate of roughly 24 cm, and it holds six sushi roll pieces plus one slice of tuna.

Roll pieces: two are California-style with sesame seeds (crab stick), two are spicy-crab rolls with tobiko-type topping, and two are cucumber and crab with orange masago. That makes six pieces at about 25-30 g each, so roughly 165 g in total. Sushi rice and filling run about 1.4 kcal/g, which gives around 230 kcal.

Tuna: this looks like a nigiri-style slice, or possibly a plain slab of tuna. It weighs about 25 g and adds roughly 35 kcal, or a bit more if there is rice underneath, which I can't see.

Total: about 190 g and about 270 kcal.
